name: awesome-soc-analyst
desc: Useful resources for SOC Analyst and SOC Analyst candidates.

resources.name: VirusTotal
resources.desc: Analyse suspicious files, domains, IPs and URLs to detect malware and other breaches, automatically share them with the security community.

resources.name: Hybrid Analysis
resources.desc: This is a free malware analysis service for the community that detects and analyzes unknown threats using a unique Hybrid Analysis technology.

resources.name: YARA
resources.desc: YARA is a multi-platform program running on Windows, Linux and Mac OS X.

resources.name: Cuckoo Sandbox
resources.desc: You can throw any suspicious file at it and in a matter of minutes Cuckoo will provide a detailed report outlining the behavior of the file when executed inside a realistic but isolated environment.

resources.name: IDA
resources.desc: IDA Pro as a disassembler is capable of creating maps of their execution to show the binary instructions that are actually executed by the processor in a symbolic representation.

resources.name: DOCGuard
resources.desc: Zero Miss for Office Malware Threats

resources.name: Immunity Debugger
resources.desc: Immunity Debugger is a dynamic analysis tool that allows executables to be analyzed at the assembly language level with reverse engineering techniques.

resources.name: DetectionLab
resources.desc: DetectionLab is a repository containing a variety of Packer, Vagrant, Powershell, Ansible, and Terraform scripts that allow you to automate the process of bringing an ActiveDirectory environment online complete with logging and security tooling using a variety of different platforms.

resources.name: attack_range
resources.desc: The Splunk Attack Range is an open-source project maintained by the Splunk Threat Research Team. It builds instrumented cloud and local environments, simulates attacks, and forwards the data into a Splunk instance.

resources.name: BlueTeam.Lab
resources.desc: The goal of this project is to provide the red and blue teams with the ability to deploy an ad-hoc detection lab to test various attacks and forensic artifacts on the latest Windows environment and then to get a 'SOC-like' view into generated data.

resources.name: MxToolbox
resources.desc: It will list MX records for a domain in priority order.

resources.name: Phishing email analysis course - FREE
resources.desc: Learn how to analysis of the most common attack vector in the cyber security industry.

resources.name: Process Hacker
resources.desc: Great tool for monitoring the system and detecting suspicious situations. It’s also free.

resources.name: Procmon
resources.desc: Procmon(Process Monitor) tool is a useful tool that provides real-time information by monitoring the activities of processes on Windows.

resources.name: Volatility
resources.desc: Volatility is a tool that enables the analysis of memory dumps taken from a compromised machine during the incident response process.

resources.name: BrowsingHistoryView
resources.desc: It gives you the history of different browsers in one table.
